legacy_v1.description: Existing V3.2 URDF masses and provisional position servos; preserve historical behavior.

shadow_v1.description: Shadow-referenced upstream positioning platform represented by TX/TY reflected translational inertia, not measured V3.2 hardware inertia or a Shadow kinematic replica.

translation.inertia_semantics: translation_armature_v1: 3 kg per orthogonal slide; no additional rigid body, Pitch inertia, gravity force, or collision geometry.

pitch.reference: Shadow WRJ1 numeric gain reference only; V3.2 forearm_pitch has a different world-axis convention.

shadow_v1.scope: Apply only when explicitly selected. Preserve V3.2 geometry, coordinate axes, joint ranges, initial pose, and position-control semantics. Other wrist axes retain their existing servo parameters.
shadow_v1.calibration_todo: V32-04: virtual platform mass, servo gains and force limits are simulation adaptations, not hardware calibration.
